instances.prompt: Cinematic music-video shot with no dialogue and no visible text. Persistent visual identity: A melancholic, psychedelic digital afterlife where organic water, bone, glass and fabric merge with restrained computational artifacts. The world feels haunted rather than technological: tactile, wet, slow, elegant and emotionally human. Persistent protagonist: The Quantum Siren: one consistent adult woman with an ageless but clearly adult presence, expressive dark eyes, translucent pale skin with subtle signal fractures, long black hair moving as if underwater, and flowing charcoal fabric. She is never a celebrity, never a real person, and never presented as a literal robot. Narrative intent: Introduce the recurring protagonist as a signal becoming human rather than a robot.. Shot action and environment: Wide underwater-like chamber with no visible walls. The Quantum Siren gradually assembles from silver mist, fine static and transparent ribbons of water, first as a distant silhouette and then as a fully coherent adult woman. Her long black hair and charcoal fabric float gently. She opens her eyes near the end while the camera performs a slow half orbit. Palette: midnight black, cold cobalt blue, deep violet, wet silver, rare restrained amber highlights. Camera language: slow deliberate dolly or orbital movement, macro detail alternating with wide negative space, deep parallax, 24 FPS cinematic motion, stable horizon unless the narrative explicitly fractures. Lighting: soft volumetric shafts, underwater caustics, flickering practical light, rim light around translucent edges, controlled highlights with rich shadow detail. Texture and atmosphere: wet glass, fine film grain, subtle analog static, liquid diffraction, bone-white organic architecture, precise but sparse pixel fragmentation. Single continuous shot, coherent anatomy, controlled motion, cinematic depth, no cuts inside the generated clip. Continuity anchors: Quantum Siren, charcoal floating fabric, translucent signal fractures.
